justification: Panel A depicts a horizontal procession of standing tribute-bearers leading a camel, while panel B shows a single seated winged figure enclosed within a circular border; there is no shared distinctive motif, relationship, or composition beyond both containing human forms. The biggest difference is the entire subject matter and layout: a linear narrative procession versus a static, radially framed composite figure with wings, which points to unrelated iconographic content despite both being figural relief carvings.'
